description: We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal full-time role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. We are looking to fill this position urgently with a leader who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and regulatory compliance. roleTitle: Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS, as an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON). This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to exceptional patient care. If you are an RN with a passion for leadership and a desire to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

As the ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality care to our residents. You will lead and mentor a team of dedicated nursing professionals, contribute to care planning, and uphold regulatory compliance, fostering an environment of excellence and compassion. Your leadership will be instrumental in maintaining our high standards of care.

This is an urgent opportunity to advance your career in a supportive and dynamic environment. Join a team committed to making a difference in the lives of those we serve.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in a clinical setting
Strong understanding of nursing best practices and regulatory compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Orientation and Mobility Specialist for a contract opportunity in Westminster, CO. This role offers a competitive rate of $55/hr+ and the chance to make a significant impact on students' lives within an educational setting. You will be instrumental in assessing and instructing students with visual impairments, empowering them to navigate their environments independently and safely.

As an Orientation and Mobility Specialist, you will develop and implement individualized O&M instruction, collaborate closely with IEP teams, and provide essential consultation to school staff and families. Your expertise will foster greater independence and enhance the educational experience for students requiring specialized support.

This is a 42-week contract position, scheduled to begin on August 5, 2026. Join a supportive environment where your skills will directly contribute to student success and well-being.
requirements: Master's degree in Orientation and Mobility
ACVREP certification as an Orientation and Mobility Specialist
Colorado Department of Education (CDE) Special Service Provider license (O&M) or eligibility
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: This contract position offers a competitive hourly rate of $55/hr+.
